Priscilla Ferreira is a reliable and capable backend engineer whose technical rigor and collaborative mindset make her a valuable asset to any team. As a peer at a large FAANG company, I’ve worked closely with her on cross-functional projects, and her contributions consistently exceed expectations.  

Priscilla joined AdVelox Technologies as a Backend Engineer, where she’s focused on building scalable ad-tech systems. Her work on AWS infrastructure scaling reduced deployment latency by 30% during peak traffic periods. She designed CI/CD pipelines that cut manual testing cycles by half, using Docker and Kubernetes to streamline container orchestration. A key project involved migrating PostgreSQL databases to cloud-native solutions, improving query performance by 25% while ensuring zero downtime.  

Her strength lies in balancing technical precision with teamwork. During a critical API integration, Priscilla debugged a complex REST API issue within 48 hours, preventing a $200K revenue loss. She also led Terraform automation for infrastructure as code, reducing configuration errors by 40%. Beyond her skills, she’s relentlessly curious and mentors junior engineers during lunch breaks.  

Priscilla’s dedication to problem-solving and her ability to thrive under pressure make her an exceptional professional. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any opportunity where technical excellence and collaboration are priorities.
